I've decided to try a video blog! My first video is on an amazing and fundamental open question, and is intended for a general audience.

```{r, eval=TRUE,echo=FALSE}
blogdown::shortcode("youtube", "7bF87e4VcmI")
```

I'd love to hear any thoughts you have on this new format!

**Note:** Since this video was created, I have learned of a paper by Aytek Erdil which resolves this question for a particular definition of truthfulness. The question remains open if we use a slightly stronger definition. If you're interested, read my posts discussing the [details of Erdil's result](https://nickarnosti.com/blog/rp_resolved/) and the [different definitions of truthfulness](https://nickarnosti.com/blog/exanteexpost/).
